newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: GOLD FIELDS TO FOCUS ON GOLD, URGES FULCO.
newsitem.headline: GOLD FIELDS TO FOCUS ON GOLD, URGES FULCO.

text.p: Gold Fields of South Africa Ltd said in its annual report it remained focused on gold operations and urged the South African mining industry to implement full calendar operations.
In his chairman's review, released with the annual report on Thursday, Robin Plumbridge said:

"The group's vision remains to focus primarily on gold, to capitalise on its world class assets and to continue to expand through exploration and investments in new selected geological and geographic areas."

While commending the government on its recognition of the need to open up the economy and its macro-economic strategy for growth, Plumbridge expressed concern at the stance adopted by the trade unions.
The group said that full calendar operations (FULCO) or continual work was essential if the South African mining industry wished to remain competitive.
Commenting on declining gold production, recently-appointed chief executive Alan Wright said:

"As a major employer of labour, it is perhaps inevitable that the mines should be subject to both unrealised and unrealistic expectations. It remains necessary to reach agreements with the relevant unions that would both satisfy worker needs and add value to the enterprise."
